title: Optimal physical approximations of pure-state cloning and transposition are complementary channels
summary: State cloning and state transposition are fundamental transformations that, despite being desirable, cannot be perfectly realised as a consequence of two distinct requirements of quantum theory: cloning is forbidden by linearity, while transposition is ruled out by complete positivity. In this work, we show that, in spite of these disparate conceptual restrictions, the best physically allowed realisation of both transformations arises from a single physical process described by an isometry, which simultaneously implements their best possible approximations.
